answer: Make the entry bond refundable only on independent conduct: your locked stake returns at its horizon, but if an audit catches any cluster acting in concert, every bond in that cluster slashes to its nadir together. One honest agent posts a single bond whose fate rides on its own behavior alone. A farm's thousand heads share one controller, so a single head caught lights a beacon that burns the whole pile; expected cost becomes the full stake times the near-certain chance that one of a thousand correlated heads trips a check.
